review.decision: Check write-time pairing and explicit clearing with delayed view notification.
review.notes: Use isolated synthetic browser pages. Hold only the notification in one page, and exercise normal save and page-hide handlers after user clearing or a fixture server refusal. Model the actual persisted credential in the existing component fixture.

cases.description: Explicit clearing wins over pending saves in other tabs
cases.setup: Disposable same-origin browser pages with a paired identity and pending input.
cases.action: Clear site storage or receive a real HTTP authorization refusal in another page. Allow the old page's timer and page-hide callback to run before it processes the notification.
cases.expected: No private composer data or bookmarks are restored. Normal credential changes still save drafts only for their original identity.
